value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for walking to 3.5 year olds with a parent, Sundays 9:30-10:15am, Sept 14 to Oct 26, $124 (plus $25 annual membership) - their site says. Registration opened July 22 and continues until classes fill. They also have Kinderfun (3-5, drop off) Saturdays 10:30am, same fall dates, $145.
